description: (Na)₂AgAlBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a AgAlBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the AgAlBr₆ framework, Ag is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form AgBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-Br bond lengths are 2.81 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form AlBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-Br bond lengths are 2.52 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ag and one Al atom.
